issue.title: Measure ACE startup cold-cache: every sase-k3 and research figure is warm-only, so the badges/repair ranking could shift
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-k3.6 (land phase of epic sase-k3, ACE startup critical path); named as follow-up 5 in plans:202608/ace_startup_critical_path.md.

Every measurement in epic sase-k3's plan, in all three research passes behind it, and in this land phase's own re-measurement is WARM: the page cache is populated by prior runs, and dropping it needs root (echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches).

This matters because both fixed phases target cold-sensitive work:
- phase sase-k3.3 (badges) removed ~19.8 MB of persisted-diff reads across 492 unique paths from the loader;
- phase sase-k3.4 (repair) removed a stat-walk of 4,706 hidden artifact directories (~8 marker stats, one read_dir, and a stat per prompt_step_*.json each) from the Tier-1 query.

Cold, the repair pass's syscall volume and the badge pass's byte volume scale very differently, so their relative ranking — and therefore the ranking of the remaining follow-ups sase-kg (mtime gate), sase-kh (prune hidden rows), and sase-ki (persist badge results) — could invert.

Scope, which is a measurement task, not a fix:
1. Establish a repeatable cold-cache procedure on athena (root drop_caches between runs, or a documented per-file posix_fadvise DONTNEED alternative if root is unacceptable).
2. Capture cold and warm ACE startup pairs using the existing recipe in docs/perf_runbook.md ('Startup telemetry capture'), reading visible_ready_seconds / all_surfaces_ready_seconds / agents_ready_seconds / axe_ready_seconds from ~/.sase/logs/tui_startup.jsonl, plus the disk loader stage via SASE_TUI_LOADER_LOG_THRESHOLD_SECONDS.
3. Report the cold budget as a table against the warm land-phase numbers recorded on bead sase-k3.6, and state whether the ranking of the outstanding follow-ups changes.
4. Add the cold procedure to docs/perf_runbook.md so later phases can reuse it.

Sized medium because the method is fully specified and bounded; the open question is the result, not the approach.

payload.entry: Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest). These are all sase-k3 land-phase follow-ups on a path the epic already fixed -- first paint no longer pays persisted diff-badge classification, hidden-row repair, or the double ProjectSpec parse. What is left here is refinement (import-graph diet, marker atomic-replace + mtime gate, persisting badge classification, cold-cache re-measurement, attributing the loader 'disk' stage), none of it a correctness defect and none with an independent reporter. The one member of this group kept open is sase-kh: hidden index rows are the growth mechanism that makes ACE startup worse every week, and the live store is now 107 MB. Re-file with a +1 and a fresh measurement if any of these becomes the dominant startup cost again.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: epic sase-k3 already took the ACE first-paint win these follow-ups refine.
